message: The other day, I found myself in a tug-of-war with my kids over their go-bags. They were more interested in packing toys than essentials, and I couldn’t help but chuckle at their priorities! It reminded me that prepping doesn't have to be all serious business. It can be a fun family activity if we let it. I ended up letting them choose one fun item each—because who says we can’t have a little joy in our readiness plan? 😊 What’s your favorite way to involve your kids in getting ready? I'd love to hear your tips!
